title: Capacity Quick Cards and Interactive Setup Microflow for Dedicated Onboarding
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a compact set of capacity 'quick cards' plus an interactive, step-by-step provisioning microflow to guide admin users through Dedicated capacity setup. The goal is to reduce cognitive load, surface autoscale and SLA trade-offs up-front, and provide a screenshot-ready flow for release notes and docs. This ticket covers visual composition, microcopy, annotated screenshots for the docs team, and deliverable-ready Figma frames for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Three compact capacity quick cards (Small/Medium/Large) exist with clear throughput, estimated cost, and latency SLO callouts
Interactive microflow prototype demonstrates the 4-step provisioning path: select capacity card, choose autoscale profile, set SLA target, confirm and view summary
All screenshots annotated and exported at 2x and 3x for product docs and release banner
Microcopy includes inline tooltips explaining autoscale burst vs. reserved capacity and SLA impact
Design tokens use approved system colors; components reuse Redwood design system CapacityCard and Stepper patterns
design_assets: Figma: Dedicated Onboarding - Capacity Quick Cards v0.9
tasks: Draft initial quick-card layouts and copy (Ava)
Prototype microflow in Figma with interactive overlays (Ravi)

Export annotated screenshots and hand off to docs
Prepare engineering spec for CapacityCard component updates
